It’s the snapshots that make the camera invaluable in efficiently recording information that has little to do with photography.   We can take hundreds of images in a week where each image is then stored as a 3MB file.  This can quickly consume available memory.

Izzi Pics is an app that allows you to take an image and compress it BEFORE it is stored.  For some images, a compressed image works just fine. WHEN IMAGE QUALITY IS CRITICAL
But there are also times when you want maximum image quality and when file size is not a consideration.   The Camera takes a great image, but it is converted to JPG (or HEIC), which is a lossy compression format. Izzi Pics allows you to take and store the image in a PNG lossless format.  In this format, information in every pixel is retained, but at the cost of a large file (~  20MB).  PNGs have a high color depth, so the format can easily handle high resolution photos.

Izzi Pics allows you to reduce the size of the stored file when a more compressed JPG file will do the job.   You control the level of image compression per shot or for a sequence of shots.
